entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been waiting forever. Listen, David, I bought these cycling shoes from you a couple of months ago and they are complete and utter garbage. I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with your purchase, sir. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could you clarify what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A technical fault? The fault is that they're terribly made! I've worn them maybe five times and I have the worst blisters of my life. They're unwearable. I'm not answering any more of your stupid questions, just process my refund or get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the discomfort the shoes have caused. There's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's about time. The email is angry.customer@email.com. And don't try to give me the runaround. I know my rights. I'll post reviews everywhere about how your products cause actual physical harm.
Thank you. I'm pulling up your account now... one moment. Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Tread cycling shoes, delivered 74 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
74 days, 100 days, I don't care. They're defective. You're going to give me my refund.

Yes, sir, I see that. And you're right. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll send it to your email right now.
Oh. So you can do it? Good. See how easy that was?

Yes, my apologies for the trouble. The email with the label has been sent. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Please make sure to remove any personal cleats you may have attached before sending the shoes back. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Fine. I've got the email. That's all I needed. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
